scope: First-garment drafting formulas for Garment Pattern Lab v0.1: sleeveless A-line woven dress/tunic, front and back panels, neckline + armhole + side flare + optional bust dart. Hybridizes a metric bodice-block tradition (Winifred Aldrich) with FreeSewing Bella's parametric construction and conventional A-line flare practice.
intended_consumer: DraftingRuleSet for the v0.1 prototype; produces a PatternGraphCandidate with two main panels.

coordinate_system.origin: top of high-point-shoulder side, on center front (front panel) or center back (back panel)
coordinate_system.x_axis: positive toward side seam (away from center)
coordinate_system.panel_left_edge: x = 0 is the fold edge (CF for front, CB for back) when cut on fold

required.label: Across-shoulder, hps to hps over back
Shoulder slope angle from horizontal at HPS
High point shoulder to bust apex (front length to bust)
HPS to waist over the front (over the bust)
HPS to waist over the back
Bust apex to bust apex (full distance)
Across back width at midpoint of armhole
Total length from HPS to hem (controls tunic vs. dress)

derived_or_optional.label: Vertical from HPS to armhole bottom
Neckline width as fraction of neck circumference
Back neck drop as fraction of neck circumference
Front neck drop as fraction of neck circumference

shoulder_width_factor.note: Multiplier on shoulder_to_shoulder; <1.0 for narrowed sleeveless armhole.

hem_sweep_added_cm.note: Total added sweep at hem above hip width, distributed equally to front and back.

bust_dart_threshold_cm.rule: If (bust - high_bust) > threshold, include a side bust dart; else dartless front.

step_order.note: Origin at HPS height, on center back.

step_order.produces: lowest point of back neckline at center back

step_order.formula: from hps, shift along slope vector at angle = -shoulder_slope (down-right) by length L; L is solved so shoulder.x = (shoulder_to_shoulder * shoulder_width_factor) / 2
step_order.geometry: L = (shoulder_to_shoulder * shoulder_width_factor / 2 - hps.x) / cos(shoulder_slope); shoulder.y = hps.y + L * sin(shoulder_slope)

step_order.note: Bella uses hps_to_waist_back * armholeDepth_option; Aldrich uses ~half back length. 0.42 is a defensible blend; expose as a tunable.
Reference notch on the armhole curve, halfway down the back armhole.
Quarter waist plus a quarter of total waist ease, since panel is half-back.
Side seam continues from hip_side at constant outward angle to hem_side, then hem returns straight to hem_center.

control_points: cpA = shoulder shifted toward (armhole_pitch_back) by ~40% of segment length
cpB_at_pitch = pitch shifted upward by ~40% of (shoulder.y to pitch.y) distance
cpC_at_pitch_lower = pitch shifted downward by ~40% of (pitch.y to armhole_bottom.y)
cpD = armhole_bottom shifted toward pitch by ~40%
step_order.note: Two-segment Bezier joined at pitch; smooth tangent at pitch by mirroring control points.

step_order.smoothing: linear segments are acceptable for v0.1; replace with smooth curve in v0.2 to remove visible kink at waist when ease at waist > ease at bust

geometry.dart_legs_at_waist: two points at waist line ±(intake/2) from dart_center_x

front_panel_construction.cut_mode_default: on_fold (CF on fold) when no front zip
front_panel_construction.shared_with_back: armhole_depth, hip line and hem position align with the back

step_order.note: Front neck width is conventionally ~0.5-1 cm wider than back: bump factor by 0.008.

step_order.formula: shoulder.x = (shoulder_to_shoulder * shoulder_width_factor) / 2; shoulder.y solved from front shoulder slope (shoulder_slope * 0.85)
step_order.note: Front shoulder slope is slightly steeper than back in Bella (factor 1.23 backward, ~0.77 forward equivalent). Practical default: shoulder.y_front = shoulder.y_back * 1.05 (front shoulder sits ~5% lower than back at the side).

step_order.formula: x = (bust / 4) * (1 + ease.bust / bust); y = same as back armhole_bottom.y
step_order.note: Front uses full-bust, back uses high-bust. Difference becomes the bust dart intake.

step_order.formula: Same as back: hip_x = (hip + ease.hip) / 4; hem_x = hip_x + hem_sweep_added / 4

step_order.note: Same construction shape as back, but front armhole is slightly deeper at the bottom and slightly more scooped under the arm. Bella uses frontArmholeCurvature ~63%.

geometry.dart_orientation: side seam (rotates intake from armhole-bust-difference into a horizontal dart at side seam)
geometry.dart_apex: shifted from bust_apex toward side seam by 2.5 cm (avoid pointing at apex)
geometry.dart_intake_cm: (bust - high_bust) / 2 distributed; one side per quarter panel
geometry.rotation_method: Bella's rotation-around-bust-apex sweep: rotate (armhole_bottom, side seam to bust line) about bust_apex by angle alpha until side seam at bust line equals (target front bust - back bust)/2

step_order.from_to: armhole_bottom -> [bust_dart_top, bust_dart_bottom if dart] -> waist_side -> hip_side -> hem_side

fix_suggestions: recompute shoulder.x with same shoulder_width_factor on both panels

validation_rules_for_v0_1.rule: front_armhole_perimeter + back_armhole_perimeter is within [0.45 * bust, 0.65 * bust]
if closure == pullover, (front_neckline_perimeter + back_neckline_perimeter) > head_circumference; head_circumference is approximately neck_circumference * 1.65 if not directly measured
front and back hem widths match within 0.5 cm at corresponding points
fix_suggestions: use same hem_sweep_added/4 on both panels

validation_rules_for_v0_1.rule: if bust dart present, dart_apex shall be 2-3 cm short of measured bust_apex point
fix_suggestions: dart_apex = bust_apex shifted toward side by 2.5 cm

notch_placement_for_v0_1.purpose: shoulder seam alignment when shoulder is curved

factor_provenance.source: Hybrid: Aldrich sleeveless block ~2.4 cm tight, +3.6 cm design ease for tunic posture
A-line tunic loose at waist; SewGuide A-line method
Match bust ease for straight side seam from bust-to-hip; Aldrich
SewGuide A-line method; conservative tunic flare

audit_notes_for_patternmaker_review: Mixing Bella factors with Aldrich ease values is intentional but unverified by a sewn muslin. Treat all ease numbers as starting defaults pending fit feedback.
Front neck width factor bumped 0.008 over back; verify on muslin that hps lands cleanly on the body.
armhole_depth blend factor 0.42 of hps_to_waist_back is a compromise between Bella's parametric form and Aldrich's half-back-length plus 1.5 cm. Either extreme is defensible; 0.42 is the midpoint.
Bust dart rotation method rotates the entire side seam segment from armhole_bottom to waist around bust_apex. This is robust but introduces a kink at waist that needs trueing if waist ease is small.
v0.1 may ship with linear (polyline) side seam between waist/hip/hem; v0.2 should replace with smooth Catmull-Rom or a single Bezier.
